Map

The map component provides functions such as map display and interaction. Related api: ma.createMapContext

Basic Map Attributes

Attribute Description

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
longitude Number No Center longitude
latitude Number No Center latitude
scale Number 16 No Zoom level. The value ranges from 3 to 20.
markers Array No Mark points
polyline Array No Route
circles Array No Circle
include-points Array No Scale the field of view to include all given coordinate points.
show-location Boolean false No Display the current anchor with direction(The positioning point obtained by the simulator does not have a direction).
bindtap Eventhandle No Triggered when a map is clicked, e.detail={longitude,latitude}
bindmarkertap Eventhandle No Triggered by clicking a map marker, e.detail={markerId}

marker

Marker points are used to display the location of the marker on the map.

Attribute Description Type Mandatory or Not Remarks
id Marker point ID Number No This ID is returned in the marker click event.
latitude latitude Number Yes floating point number, ranging from - 90 to 90
longitude longitude Number Yes floating point number, ranging from - 180 to 180
title Mark the roll call String No Display when clicked
iconPath Displayed Icons String No Image path in the project path. Only the local path is supported.
width width of the mark icon Number No default to the actual width of the image
height height of the mark icon Number No default to the actual height of the image
anchor The longitude and latitude are in the anchor point of the annotation icon. The default value is the middle point at the bottom. Object No {x,y}. x indicates horizontal (0 - 1), and y indicates vertical (0 - 1). {x:0.5,y:1} indicates the midpoint of the bottom edge.(The simulator does not support this attribute)

polyline

Specifies a series of coordinate points, from the first line of the array to the last line. When drawing a rainbow line, you need to specify the colors of different segments. For example, if points contain five points, four color values must be transferred in colorList. If the length of colorList is less than points.length - 1, the color of the remaining segments is the same as that of the last item.

Attribute Description Type Mandatory or Not Remarks
points longitude and latitude array Array Yes [{latitude:0,longitude:0}]
color Line color String No Hexadecimal, for example, #FFFFFF.The default value is '# 000000'.
colorList Rainbow line Array No Ignore the color if it exists, for example, ['#FF0000','#00FF00','#0000FF','#112233','#223344'].The default value is ['#000000'].
width line width Number No

circle

Display a circle on a map

Attribute Description Type Mandatory or Not Remarks
latitude latitude Number Yes floating point number, ranging from - 90 to 90
longitude longitude Number Yes floating point number, ranging from - 180 to 180
color stroke color String No hexadecimal.The default value is '#000000'.
fillColor Fill Color String No Hexadecimal
radius radius Number No

Sample Code

// index.maml

 <map id="myMap" show-location="{{showLocation}}" scale="{{scale}}" markers="{{markers}}" polyline="{{polyline}}" longitude="{{longitude}}" latitude="{{latitude}}" include-points="{{includePoints}}" circles="{{circles}}" bindmarkertap="markerTap" bindtap="mapTap"></map>



// index.js 
Page({
  data: {
    markers: [],
    latitude: 31.97934,
    longitude: 118.7673113,
    circles: [
      {
        latitude: 31.9782417,
        longitude: 118.7661415,
        radius: 20,
        color: '#87CEEB',
      }
    ],
    includePoints: [
      {
        latitude: 31.9751427,
        longitude: 118.7672672,
      },
      {
        latitude: 31.9782417,
        longitude: 118.7661415,
      },
      {
        latitude: 31.97934,
        longitude: 118.7673113,
      }
    ],
    polyline: [
      {
        points: [
          {
            latitude: 31.9751427,
            longitude: 118.7672672,
          },
          {
            latitude: 31.9782417,
            longitude: 118.7661415,
          }
        ],
        color: '#FFFFFF'
      }
    ],
    showLocation: false,
    scale: 18,
  },
   markerTap(e) {
    ma.showModal({
      content: `markerTap${e}`,
    });
  },
  mapTap(e) {
    ma.showModal({
      content: `mapTap${e}`,
    });
  },
  })

Tips

  1. The value of color, fillColor, and colorList on the map must be a six-digit hexadecimal number. For example, #87CEEB.
  2. If the longitude and latitude of the map component are not specified, the longitude and latitude of the Beijing are used by default.
